summary: Final stable promotion of the tested v1.3.0-rc.15 application and firmware payload.
notes: Application, firmware artifact, protocol, runtime dependencies and execution-data capabilities are identical to tested rc.15. The development-worktree changes in PR #6 are excluded.

Promotes stable discovery to v1.3.0. Because immutable legacy clients select the stable pointer directly, this target explicitly declares only the existing v1.2.0-rc.6, v1.2.0 and v1.3.0-rc.1 migration cohorts. The separate release-candidate pointer remains pinned to rc.11.

Direct legacy migration requires the existing operator-reviewed source, external machine-data activation and verification workflow. Declaration of compatibility does not authorize hardware operation or establish installed-firmware provenance; verify the existing released firmware/recovery binding separately.

No configured app rollback is advertised. Preserve execution-calibration version-4 history and use protected current-version recovery or an exactly qualified compatible offline bundle. v1.2.0 is not an automatic rollback target.

The accepted rc.13 optimizer timing limitation and rc.15 qualification boundaries remain: occasional large-calculation UI pauses, no new long-session memory qualification, and no new physical-hardware qualification for this metadata-only promotion.
Release preparation only. Tagging, publication, advancing main/stable, and deployment remain pending. See docs/v1.3.0_release_qualification.md for current validation and any blockers.
